title: Play UNO SHOW ‘EM NO MERCY Anywhere! (Resource Pack)
description: Play UNO and draw 10 cards to your friend in Minecraft because why not?
body:
# Play UNO SHOW ‘EM NO MERCY Anywhere! (Resource Pack)

Have you ever imagined playing UNO in Minecraft? Now, your dream comes true – not only classic UNO, but UNO SHOW ‘EM NO MERCY!

**This is the required resource pack for [“Play UNO SHOW ‘EM NO MERCY Anywhere!” data pack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/play-uno-senm-anywhere-dp).**

![The image shows the full deck of UNO SHOW ‘EM NO MERCY cards (duplicated cards ignored)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4092a8f4e4631c3d4bade8ae4c2a5d4d386eccea.png)

## Installation

This is the required resource pack for [“Play UNO SHOW ‘EM NO MERCY Anywhere!” data pack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/play-uno-senm-anywhere-dp). **BOTH the data pack and the resource pack have to be installed or loaded to play.**

There is a page on Minecraft Wiki guiding you to [load this resource pack](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Tutorial:Loading_a_resource_pack).

## Credits

“Play UNO SHOW ‘EM NO MERCY Anywhere!” data pack is adapted from “Play UNO Anywhere!” ([Introduction Video](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Ga3JzpEZS/)) by [Zeyo Octopus](https://space.bilibili.com/88078264).
